pages.text: $(l)Living Root Grasp$() roots and binds enemies with living vines, immobilizing them.$(br2)$(l)Max Level:$() 6$(br)$(l)Type:$() Control$(br)$(l)Botania Mana Cost:$() 15,000 + 7,500/level$(br2)Applies Slowness to the target. With the $(o)livingRootImmobilize$() config option (default: true), this becomes full immobilization. Duration increases with spell level.

pages.title: Scribing the Scroll
pages.text: Scrolls are not crafted at a table. Set a $(l)Scroll Forge$() with $(l)Uncommon Ink$() and a Botany focus — a $(l)Spell Petal$(), a $(l)Botanical Focus$(), or any item tagged $(t)#ironsbotany:focus/botany$() — then choose $(l)Living Root Grasp$() from the spell list.$(br2)The ink rarity sets the highest spell level the forge will scribe, so richer ink is the only way to reach the upper levels of this spell.
